description: Accrued annual leave at a date (UAE Art. 29: 30 days/year, 2 days/month between 6 and 12 months; Saudi Art. 109: 21 days, 30 after 5 years), balance after days taken, and encashment value at the legal basis wage. Example: country 'AE', start_date '2024-01-15', as_of_date '2026-10-31', taken_days 20, basic_monthly_wage 6000.  Response: result with legal_basis (article) and explanation[] steps, data_confidence (high = official text; medium = translation or recent amendment via secondary source), estimated_items[], sources[] (law URLs), data_version, warnings[] and a not-legal-advice disclaimer.

as_of_date.description: Date to compute the accrual at (e.g. today or the last working day).
as_of_date.title: As Of Date

country.description: country: 'AE' (UAE private sector, Decree-Law 33/2021) or 'SA' (Saudi Labor Law M/51 incl. 2025 amendments).
country.title: Country

taken_days.description: Annual-leave days already taken/paid in the period.
taken_days.title: Taken Days

total_monthly_wage.description: For encashment value where total wage applies (SA).
total_monthly_wage.title: Total Monthly Wage
